description: Before you attribute a quote to a source, check that the exact words really appear on that page. Returns found (true only for verbatim or punctuation/case-only differences), match_type (exact | normalized | near | partial | none), similarity 0-1, the closest_match text actually on the page with surrounding context, and safe_to_quote. Use closest_match to correct misquotes.

quote.description: The quoted text to look for (3-3000 chars)

url.description: Page that supposedly contains the quote

name: verify_quote
title: Verify a quote appears on a page
